title: Lost phone, lost account and continuity

sections.skill: Prepare recovery options and a short continuity plan

questions.prompt: What are backup codes for two-step login?

choices.text: Codes that turn off two-step security forever
One-time codes to sign in if the phone is lost

questions.correct_answer: One-time codes to sign in if the phone is lost
questions.intro: A business should keep running if something goes wrong: a lost phone, a hacked email, a sick owner. Prepare RECOVERY OPTIONS: backup codes for two-step login stored safely, an up-to-date recovery email and phone, and knowledge of how to reach each service's support. Write a short CONTINUITY PLAN: where key information is, who can step in for urgent tasks, and how customers will be told about delays. Test the plan once, for example by logging in with backup codes.

sections.skill: A spare house key and a neighbor

questions.prompt: Backup codes are like what?
questions.intro: Many people leave a spare key with a trusted neighbor and tell them which plants need water if they are away. If they lose their own key, they can still get in; if they are sick, the neighbor can help. Backup codes are the spare key. A continuity plan is the note telling the neighbor what to do.
